summary: Verified new Invoices-tab advanced filters (Warehouse popover + Month + FY + Payment Status + memo_no search) end-to-end. Backend: 20/20 new pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_invoice_advanced_filters.py (fy, month/year, payment_status Paid/Partial/Pending, memo_no substring search, combined warehouse+fy+payment_status+status, pagination preservation, xlsx export honouring all params, fake-wh returns 0, invalid FY gracefully ignored, employee 403). Frontend (admin @ /gst-billing): all 12 new/verified data-testids present and functional — search-input, invoice-warehouse-filter, status-filter, payment-status-filter, bill-type-filter, fy-filter, month-filter, start-date, end-date, export-excel-btn, invoice-results-count, warehouse-filter-trigger. FY dropdown shows exactly 'All FYs' + 5 Indian FYs (2026-27..2022-23). Selecting FY 2026-27 correctly disables start-date/end-date and updates chip 'Showing 33 of 33 invoices · FY 2026-27'. Month dropdown shows 'All Months' + 12 month names; July selection auto-resets FY and shows 'Month: July'. Payment dropdown has 'All Payments/Paid/Partial/Pending' — chip shows 'Payment: Paid' when Paid selected. Search 'search-input' now matches memo_no (typed '11111' returned exactly 1 row whose memo_no='11111' — previously would not match). Warehouse per-tab popover has 4 warehouse items; selecting Jullang updated BOTH header 'warehouse-filter-trigger' label and tab 'invoice-warehouse-filter' label to 'Jullang' (state shared, spec 1b). reset-filters-btn appears only when a filter differs from default; clicking it restores all defaults. Employee lock verified via curl: GET /api/gst/invoices returns 403 as expected. Header KPI cards (Total Invoices/Active/Cancelled/Total GST Collected) now reflect warehouse_ids + payment_status + fy filters — the iteration_58 summary-endpoint bug is FIXED.

issues: React dev-time hydration console warnings: '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>' and '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>' (see /app/frontend/src/pages/GSTBilling.jsx around line 1386-1388). Caused by an emergent x-source wrapper <span style={display:contents}> being rendered around each <tr>. Non-blocking (rows render and are interactive) but should be cleaned up because hydration warnings can hide real ones in production. Not a functional issue.

action_items: (Optional / non-blocking) Investigate the <span data-ve-dynamic> wrapper injected around <tr> inside <tbody> in GSTBilling.jsx (~L1386) — produces React hydration warnings but does not break UI.
No functional bugs — feature is fully working and ready for release.
critical_code_review_comments: list_invoices, get_invoice_summary and export_invoices_excel now all accept the same superset of filter params (fy, month, year, payment_status, item_type, warehouse_ids, search) — consistent and clean.
FY parsing (gst_billing.py L720-725, L794-799, L1039-1045) is duplicated 3x — consider extracting into a helper `date_range_from_fy(fy)` to avoid drift.
memo_no was added to the search $or in both list_invoices (L1050) and export_invoices_excel (L802) — good parity.
Frontend correctly threads state-sharing between header warehouse-filter-trigger and tab-level invoice-warehouse-filter (verified: selecting Jullang in one updates both labels).
reset-filters-btn conditional-render logic works as spec — button hidden when defaults are in effect.
GSTBilling.jsx is now 3414 lines — approaching maintainability limit. Consider splitting InvoicesTab, WarehousesTab, DiscrepanciesTab, PartyLedgerTab into separate files to reduce cognitive load.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all filter data-testids, dropdowns, chips, state-sharing, reset button, mutual-exclusion (fy vs month vs date-range), and memo_no search verified
